variantMatrix: variant (2) x size (2) x state (5) = 20 combinations, all present in the Figma component set

structural._note: Fixed for every brand. A brand wrapper may not change these without a contract version bump.
structural.borderWidth: 2px solid, always present (including default/primary, where it's transparent) so focus never shifts layout

sizes._note: Changed in 0.5.0 to follow Figma's reworked Spacing collection. Large was 24px inline / 16px block; it is now 16 / 12. Small is unchanged in pixels (16 / 8) but its tokens were renamed. Every value is now on the scale — the 24px inline padding that 0.4.3 documented as 'off-scale, not a token' is gone from Button entirely, and 24px is itself a token now (spacing.m) that Button no longer uses.

structural.tracking: -0.02em on both sizes, carried by the type tokens rather than the component. New in 0.5.0: 0.4.3 documented both button steps as sitting at normal tracking.

brandOverridable._note: A brand theme may redefine these CSS custom properties. Structure and which state maps to which token stays fixed; only the resolved value changes.

radius.full.usedFor: corner radius, both sizes and both variants

color.primary.500.usedFor: primary / default fill, secondary / default border

locked._note: Shared neutrals and the spacing steps the size matrix is built from. Not brand-specific by design — disabled should look the same regardless of brand, and a brand may not reshape the button's footprint.

color.grey.100.usedFor: primary / disabled fill, secondary / disabled text
